doctor_routes.override_rule: An outcome override replaces the row screen only on rows marked overridable - rows where Adapter:key(2|3) is unclaimed (or refused while playing with a READY bank) - so a visible screen never hides a live confirmation, draft or Finish. The playing_gate row is not overridable: R11 shows the selected lane itself.
doctor_routes.payload: Every doctor grid outcome payload carries doctor_state, modal_operation, draft, preview and playing read after the original callback ran, plus outcome. A payload missing a key is a contract error, not a default.
doctor_routes.derivation: for each row: alternative {when: row.when, screen: row.screen, priority: 10}; for each override and each listed row: {when: row.when + {outcome}, screen: override.screen, priority: 20}.
